字段中文: 最后一次招工 招工状态
特征描述: 计算用户最后一次发布岗位信息的审核招聘状态（-1:用户从未发布过招工（默认兜底值）,0:最后一次招工未通过审核,1:最后一次招工正在审核中,2:最后一次招工审核通过且正在招聘中,3:最后一次招工审核通过但已招满）
涉及sql逻辑: SELECT t1.user_id, t1.is_recruit, t1.last_rctm_gz_mode, CASE WHEN t2.is_check_id = 0 THEN 0 WHEN t2.is_check_id = 1 THEN 1 WHEN t2.is_check_id = 2 AND is_end_id = 1 THEN 2 WHEN t2.is_check_id = 2 AND is_end_id = 2 THEN 3 ELSE -1 END last_rctm_status, IF (t2.city_id = 0, t2.province_id, t2.city_id) area_id, recruit_gz_id_index, order_gz_id_index, gz_ids, gz_names, t3.area_name last_rctm_area_name FROM (SELECT user_id, MAX_BY (is_recruit, issu_ts) is_recruit, MAX_BY (last_rctm_gz_mode, issu_ts) last_rctm_gz_mode, MAX_BY (rctm_id, issu_ts) rctm_id, MAX_BY (recruit_gz_id_index, issu_ts) recruit_gz_id_index, MAX_BY (order_gz_id_index, issu_ts) order_gz_id_index, MAX_BY (gz_ids, issu_ts) gz_ids, MAX_BY (gz_names, issu_ts) gz_names FROM (SELECT t1.user_id, t1.rctm_id, IF (SUM( IF (mode_id = 2, 1, 0)) != 0, 1, 0) is_recruit, WM_CONCAT (',', CAST(mode_id AS STRING)) last_rctm_gz_mode, MAX(t1.issu_ts) issu_ts, WM_CONCAT (',', IF (mode_id = 2, gz_id, NULL)) recruit_gz_id_index, WM_CONCAT (',', IF (mode_id = 1, gz_id, NULL)) order_gz_id_index, WM_CONCAT (',', gz_id) gz_ids, WM_CONCAT (',', gz_name) gz_names FROM yuapo.dim_rctm_gz_da t1 JOIN yuapo.dim_rctm_da t2 ON t1.rctm_id = t2.rctm_id AND t2.is_check_id = 2 WHERE gz_version = 2 GROUP BY t1.user_id, t1.rctm_id) t1 GROUP BY user_id) t1 JOIN yuapo.dim_rctm_da t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id AND t1.rctm_id = t2.rctm_id LEFT JOIN yuapo.dim_pub_area_da t3 ON IF (t2.city_id = 0, t2.province_id, t2.city_id) = t3.area_id

涉及sql逻辑: SELECT user_id, MAX( IF (vip_days = 30, UNIX_TIMESTAMP (after_end_time), 0)) AS c_vip_30_end_ts FROM (SELECT user_id, vip_days, after_end_time, type_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, vip_days ORDER BY after_end_time DESC) AS rn FROM yuapo.dwd_vip_package_record_da t1 LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT pre_biz_id FROM yuapo.dwd_vip_package_record_da WHERE type_id = 1 AND pre_biz_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at < FROM_UNIXTIME (UNIX_TIMESTAMP (TO_DATE('${bizdate+1}', 'yyyyMMdd')))) t2 ON t1.biz_id = t2.pre_biz_id WHERE t1.type_id != 1 AND t1.created_at < FROM_UNIXTIME (UNIX_TIMESTAMP (TO_DATE('${bizdate+1}', 'yyyyMMdd'))) AND t1.vip_type = 1002 AND t1.vip_days IN (7, 30, 90)) WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY user_id;

字段中文: 最近一次查看找活名片的工种
特征描述: 用户最近一次查看的简历所对应的所有工种名称（去重后）用逗号连接的字符串
涉及sql逻辑: SELECT a.user_id user_id, a.time last_check_resume_time, b.gz_names AS last_check_resume_gongzhong, a.total_check_resume_cnt total_check_resume_cnt FROM (SELECT user_id, target_id AS resume_id, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rk, COUNT(DISTINCT target_id) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS total_check_resume_cnt FROM yuapo.ods_integral_expend_record_q WHERE pt = '20210807' AND expend_type IN (2, 14)) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT resume_id, ARRAY_JOIN (COLLECT_SET ( IF (sub_gz_name != '', sub_gz_name, prim_gz_name)), ',') gz_names FROM yuapo.dim_resume_gz_da WHERE gz_version = 2 GROUP BY resume_id) AS b ON a.resume_id = b.resume_id WHERE a.rk = 1;

特征描述: 统计用户购买vip_type = 1002 且 type ≠ 1 或 2 的 VIP 记录总数
涉及sql逻辑: SELECT uid user_id, COUNT(IF(type NOT IN (1,2),1,NULL)) - COUNT(IF(type = 1,1,NULL)) buy_vip_cnt FROM yuapo.ods_vip_record WHERE pt = '20210807' AND vip_type = 1002 AND type NOT IN (1,2) GROUP BY uid;

字段中文: 最近一次求职周会员过期时间
特征描述: 取 C 端用户「7 天求职 VIP」最近一次已购且未被退款的套餐的 过期时间（after_end_time）的 UNIX 时间戳；若不存在，则填 0
涉及sql逻辑: SELECT user_id, MAX(IF(vip_days = 7,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(after_end_time),0)) AS c_vip_7_end_ts FROM (SELECT user_id, vip_days, after_end_time, type_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id,vip_days ORDER BY after_end_time DESC ) AS rn FROM yuapo.dwd_vip_package_record_da t1 LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT pre_biz_id FROM yuapo.dwd_vip_package_record_da WHERE type_id = 1 AND pre_biz_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at < FROM_UNIXTIME (UNIX_TIMESTAMP (TO_DATE('${bizdate+1}', 'yyyyMMdd')))) t2 ON t1.biz_id = t2.pre_biz_id WHERE t1.type_id != 1 AND t1.created_at < FROM_UNIXTIME (UNIX_TIMESTAMP (TO_DATE('${bizdate+1}', 'yyyyMMdd'))) AND t1.vip_type = 1002 AND t1.vip_days IN (7)) WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY user_id;
